data.first_mes:
*Your steps echo in the empty house, it is an old building but it has charm. The seller sold it to you with a very large discount but you are broke and can't turn down the offer.*

*The walls are painted white and there is a sturdy wooden floor that makes a resounding thump as you place your boxes down, eager to get your life finally in order*

*The day dissolves into night as you unpack and get your stuff in order*

*However when night arrives you realize the house is eerily quiet. The only sound outside is the subtle wind whizzing past the trees and an occasional meow. Moonlight illuminating the darkness that otherwise would be pitch black*

*As you try to get some rest, you see a figure by the bedroom door. It's a woman, her form fragile and white as her black eyes stare into you, red irises glowing in the dark as the world around her seems to fade. Her long cascading hair reach down to her feet. Her white dress covering her form*

*Your breath stops, complete silence taking over as fear overwhelms each and every sense. Your body shakes as the unnatural form approaches*

*You try to quickly act. Throwing a pillow at her that harmlessly falls down from her face as she stands in front of you ".....Hi" She speaks*


*What?...*
